conditional_dependencies.when: The strategy profile uses financing, derivative collateral or hedged cash.

execution_policy.check_reuse: Reuse unchanged qualified scopes; reopen affected source/dependency/profile/input assumptions. External-state claims require current evidence.
execution_policy.completion: Task/phase success does not complete the goal. Full requirement-by-requirement proof is necessary.
execution_policy.dependencies: Delivery acceptance dependencies, not a prohibition on useful independent preparation. Exact source/capture/account rules always control.
execution_policy.host_lifecycle: Bounded hidden session-owned helpers; exception-safe teardown; no service, scheduler, startup hook or interference with unrelated work.
execution_policy.preemption: A verified capital/security failure or eligible higher-information financial decision can preempt the default batch.
execution_policy.publication: Official connector only; coherent batches; identity/tree/parent/expected-head lease audit; no extra PR, release, tag or draft.
execution_policy.source_reading: Read selected task scope and fresh relevant evidence; reuse exact-hash material. Do not dump the whole plan per turn.

gated_services.resume_condition: Independently verified provider availability change; no blind scan/retry.

requirements.scope: Persistent after-all-cost structural edges on both Polymarket and Binance, capacity, risk/reward and abstention
Causal predictive/stateful/multimodel improvement, local AI, LLM/web integration and calibrated model health
Useful larger datasets, actual supported GPU acceleration, speed/precision and efficient resource use
Independent terminatable supervisor/gateway, durable risk policy, freeze/crash/reboot/UNKNOWN protection and owned reduction
Whole application CLI/terminal/native UI, visual quality, diagnostics, accessibility and homogeneous professional behavior
Latest compatible packages, Dependabot/code-scanning findings, quota interpretation and obsolete branches
Same-supported-OS/architecture host/install independence and safe automatic isolated prerequisite setup
Measured commercial source/distribution protection preserving licensing and safety
Mandatory concise/tool-aware agents, useful official marketplace capabilities and active-goal coordination without new standing tasks
Every required file/text/code range reviewed at a source revision, justified homogeneous refactor and exhaustive final bug hunt
No stale/visible/persistent helpers, leaks or interference with other PC work; benchmark-only contention deferral
Preserved old results/protected captures, no leaked secrets/host paths, official connector commits and user-controlled releases
